provenance.title: THE HOLONOMY BRAIDING FOR Uξ(sl2) IN TERMS OF GEOMETRIC QUANTUM DILOGARITHMS

candidates.statement: The modules $\rep{\hat \chi}$ form a nontrivial vector bundle over $\mathop{\mathrm{Spec}}\Wcharhat$; to describe the matrices $R$ we need to choose concrete $\mathcal{W}_{\xi}$-module structures on them, i.e. we must locally trivialize.
This scalar is $\Upsilon$, and because $\jfunc$ is continuous it must be as well. ◻ :::
Thus $\Upsilon$ is a discrete-valued, continuous function on a connected space, so it must be constant.

For the negative case [\[eq:R-mat-negative-phi-form\]](#eq:R-mat-negative-phi-form){reference-type="eqref" reference="eq:R-mat-negative-phi-form"} we must also use the relation $\zeta_{\lN}^{0} + \zeta_{\lS}^{0} = \zeta_{\lW}^{0} + \zeta_{\lE}^{0}$ and the inversion relation [@Faddeev2001 equation (16)], which in our conventions is $$\label{eq:pf inversion relation} \pf{\zeta} \pf{- \zeta - 1} = (1 - \omega^{- N\zeta}) \exp\left( \frac{ \pi i (N+ 1/N) }{ 12 } - \frac{\pi i}{N} \left[ \zeta - \frac{N-1}{2} \right]^{2} \right) .$$ ◻ :::
